scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of stationary uniqueness in the asymptotic high-self-shading regime. Numerical verification is corroborative only; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The positive threshold for attenuation is not explicit. Strict invasion supercriticality and fixed strictly positive rates are required. This does not assert stationary uniqueness at arbitrary attenuation, stability or any result for the infected model. Equivalent literature not captured by primary-source access or indexing remains a risk.
title: Strong self-shading selects a unique phytoplankton equilibrium and its first nutrient correction
